title: Lifestyle questionnaire questions
description: clinical-content/rules/lifestyle-questions.json: the patient questionnaire questions on religious / ritual fasting and traditional or complementary treatments (patient-facing wording, information only) and their "(patient-reported)" line labels. A shared clinical rule file read by the web (lib/triage-engine/src/lifestyle-questions.ts, APCQ) and iOS (LifestyleQuestions.swift through SharedClinicalContent). Part of the lifestyle-practices rule set: its version is the registry contentVersion of lifestyle-practices.

questions.description: Question key -> question, in the order they are asked.

lineLabels.description: Question key -> the social-history line label ("Fasting (patient-reported)"); the line is "<label>: <answer>".
